notableFeatures: A series of notches are carved into the blade, one for each kill.
The grip is worn smooth in one particular spot from long use.
It is perfectly balanced for throwing, even if not designed for it.
It makes a faint, almost inaudible whistling sound when swung.
The maker's mark is an unusual, unidentifiable symbol.
It never seems to get dirty or require cleaning.
It feels heavier than it looks, and strikes with surprising force.
Fine script rings the guard, too small to read without a lens.
A shallow groove channels blood away from the hand.
The edge shows a wave pattern like ripples on a pond.
A hairline crack forms a shape like a lightning bolt.
The pommel unscrews to reveal a tiny compartment.
Tiny bells on the tassel never make a sound.
A faded ribbon is tied beneath the guard.
There is a chip shaped like a crescent moon.
Every time you glance away, it lies at a slightly different angle.
The scabbard (if any) smells faintly of wintergreen.
A prayer is scratched into the inside of the guard.
The weapon grows cool in sunlight and warm at night.
When knocked, it answers with a hollow, echoing tone.
A bead of red enamel marks the balance point.
The haft has tally marks grouped in sevens.
The quillons depict birds taking flight.
A single hair is trapped beneath the lacquer.
The grip hides a sewn-in lock of someone’s hair.
Its reflection lags a heartbeat behind movements.
In rain, droplets avoid the edge and cling to the flat.
Runes only show when breathed upon.
A small dent perfectly fits the wielder’s thumb.
A faint ring appears around it during dawn light.

blade: Notches line the blade, each marked with a different date.
The metal shows a wave pattern like ripples on a pond.
The pommel unscrews to reveal a tiny compartment.
Fine script rings the guard, too small to read without a lens.
axe: The axe head bears a crescent-shaped repair of brighter metal.
Tally marks climb the haft in groups of seven.
One face of the head is polished while the other remains dark.
hammer: The striking face leaves a faint geometric imprint on soft material.
The head rings like a distant bell when tapped.
A maker's oath is stamped beneath the hammer head.
polearm: Bands of engraved metal reinforce the long shaft.
A faded ribbon is tied just below the weapon's head.
The butt cap contains a small sealed compartment.
bow: Tiny carvings follow the curve of both limbs.
The string sounds a clear musical note when plucked.
The bow flexes without the faintest creak.
crossbow: The release mechanism is engraved with interlocking leaves.
A hidden notch in the stock holds a spare string.
The bow locks into place with an unusually soft click.
sling: The pouch bears a map stitched in colored thread.
One cord ends in a bead carved like a watchful eye.
The cords whistle in harmony when spun.

magicalProperties.name: Scorching
magicalProperties.description: Kindles with controlled flame when readied and leaves searing marks on what it strikes.

magicalProperties.name: Rimebound
magicalProperties.description: Gathers white frost in danger and spreads numbing cold through a solid strike.

magicalProperties.name: Shocking
magicalProperties.description: Crackles with blue sparks that leap across metal and wet surfaces.

magicalProperties.name: Venomous
magicalProperties.description: Produces a supernatural venom that weakens living creatures without endangering its bearer.

magicalProperties.name: Steadfast
magicalProperties.description: Steadies its bearer against supernatural fear and panic.

magicalProperties.name: Returning
magicalProperties.description: Flies back to its bearer's grasp when called by name.

magicalProperties.name: Unerring
magicalProperties.description: Subtly guides each strike toward a weakness the bearer can perceive.

magicalProperties.name: Radiant
magicalProperties.description: Shines like dawn and burns creatures animated by unholy power.

magicalProperties.name: Grave-Touched
magicalProperties.description: Drinks warmth from whatever it strikes and grows cold near restless dead.

magicalProperties.name: Thunderclap
magicalProperties.description: Can release the sound and force of a thunderclap through a mighty strike.

magicalProperties.name: Frostbrand
magicalProperties.description: Extinguishes ordinary flame when readied and shields its bearer from bitter cold.

magicalProperties.name: Emberwake
magicalProperties.description: Ignites in bright, smokeless flame at its bearer's command.

magicalProperties.name: Binding
magicalProperties.description: Spectral cords briefly hinder a creature struck by the weapon.

magicalProperties.name: Wounding
magicalProperties.description: Leaves injuries that resist ordinary treatment until the weapon is put away.

magicalProperties.name: Bane of Beasts
magicalProperties.description: Warns of nearby predatory beasts and strikes them with unnatural force.

magicalProperties.name: Bane of the Restless
magicalProperties.description: Glows near the restless dead and can drive such spirits from the living.

magicalProperties.name: Spellguard
magicalProperties.description: Raises a brief shimmer of protection when hostile magic reaches its bearer.

magicalProperties.name: Featherlight
magicalProperties.description: Feels nearly weightless to its chosen bearer without losing force or stability.

magicalProperties.name: Phase-Step
magicalProperties.description: Lets its bearer take a single step through a nearby solid barrier before its magic must recover.

magicalProperties.name: Sentinel
magicalProperties.description: Tugs toward approaching danger and moves quickly to intercept it.

magicalProperties.name: Severing
magicalProperties.description: Can cut or break materials that would turn an ordinary weapon.

magicalProperties.name: Quiet Strike
magicalProperties.description: Makes no sound when readied, moved, or used in battle.

magicalProperties.name: Sapping
magicalProperties.description: Drains vigor from a struck foe and briefly transfers it to the bearer.

magicalProperties.name: Guiding
magicalProperties.description: Marks a struck foe with a faint light that guides the bearer's allies.

magicalProperties.name: Sunbound
magicalProperties.description: Sheds true sunlight on command and blazes against creatures of darkness.

magicalProperties.name: Moonsong
magicalProperties.description: Sings beneath moonlight and sharpens its bearer's perception after dusk.

magicalProperties.name: Stormcall
magicalProperties.description: Calls wind and lightning to answer a strike made beneath the open sky.

magicalProperties.name: Gravitic
magicalProperties.description: Can become immovably anchored until its bearer releases it.

magicalProperties.name: Echoing
magicalProperties.description: A particularly forceful strike can repeat as a spectral echo a heartbeat later.

magicalProperties.name: True North
magicalProperties.description: Points toward a place chosen by its bearer when held still.
